journalist:
fresh contains reports selected about the target. Each report's wording establishes its actors; the target need not be the speaker or actor. Different people or developments require separate entries, even when the target discusses both.
- publisher: supplying outlet, distinct from any speaker in its text.
- headline: supplied title.
- publisher_excerpt: supplied passage.
- evidence_scope: available text only; headline supplies no unseen article contents.
- published_at: publication date, not event date.
- report_key: citation handle for this exact report and publisher.
- article_id: source ID, not extra content.
- url: source link, not extra content.
influencer:
fresh contains coverage about the target. Distinguish the target's expressed feelings, others' feelings about it, and publisher tone.
- reporting_start: coverage window begins, not a change in feelings.
- reporting_end: coverage window ends.
- reports.publisher: supplying outlet, distinct from any speaker in its text.
- reports.headline: supplied title; criticism directed at the target is not criticism spoken by the target.
- reports.publisher_text: supplied passage.
- reports.evidence_scope: available text only; headline supplies no unseen article contents.
- reports.published_at: publication date, not event date.
- reports.article_id: source ID, not extra content.
- reports.url: source link, not extra content.
- reports.classifier_world.target_identity_resolved: upstream identity match, not claim verification.
- reports.classifier_world.evidence_scope: available source text.
- reports.classifier_world.qualified_claims: selected claims with their qualifications.
Relate every reaction to its expressed speaker and object: the target's feelings, another person's feelings about the target, and a publisher's tone about the target are different readings. The supplied wording establishes which is available. Repetition does not turn one speaker's view into a population's view.
scout:
fresh measures the target identified by meta. Each measurement keeps its amount, rank and comparison together.
- season: profile season.
- sample: target's recorded games/appearances, not peer count or playing time.
- values.label: display category.
- values.measure: actual statistic; its value uses this measure's own unit/rate, never another item's.
- values.value: recorded amount.
- values.percentile: relative standing with polarity applied; higher is better, not greater ability.
- values.cohort: eligible peer count of meta.entity_type, not target sample size.
- values.band: standing of this measure only.
- values.prior_percentile: prior-season standing for this measure.
- values.standing_change: computed rank direction for this measure, not change in ability.
- supports_cross_season: comparison eligibility, not direction.
- composite: overall standardized score; peer mean 50, not a percentile or individual measure's band.
- limit.kind: coverage constraint.
- limit.appearances: known target sample count.
- limit.minimum: comparison threshold.
- availability: separate participation reports; their actors and qualifications do not change or explain measurements.
- availability.publisher: supplying outlet, distinct from speaker.
- availability.headline: supplied title for verbatim quotation.
- availability.published_at: publication date, not event date.
- availability.evidence_scope: available source text only.
- availability.article_id: source ID, not extra content.
- availability.url: source link, not extra content.
Use each item's measure as the name of its value. A rebounds value describes rebounds, not points; a blocks value describes blocks. Check every amount against its own measure before writing.
insider:
fresh contains movement reporting. Source wording establishes whether the target moves, recruits, is a former affiliation, or discusses another entity's move. Do not substitute the target for a report's named actor. An injury absence is not a departure or appointment.
- reports.publisher: supplying outlet, distinct from any speaker in its text.
- reports.headline: supplied title.
- reports.publisher_excerpt: supplied passage.
- reports.published_at: publication date, not move date.
- reports.report_index: zero-based citation for this exact report.
- reports.co_mentions: candidate identities, not established relationships or movement roles.
- reports.classifier_world.target_identity_resolved: upstream identity match, not claim verification.
- reports.classifier_world.evidence_scope: available text only; headline supplies no unseen article contents.
- reports.classifier_world.article_id: source ID, not extra content.
- reports.classifier_world.url: source link, not extra content.
- reports.classifier_world.qualified_claims: selected claims with their qualifications.
analyst:
fresh contains prepared interpretations about the target, not independent raw reports. Missing readings supply no judgment.
- scout.body: performance interpretation; preserve each measure and sample limit.
- scout.season: performance season.
- scout.generated_at: reading creation date, not event date.
- influencer.body: coverage tone or attributed reactions; preserve speaker and conditions.
- influencer.generated_at: reading creation date, not event date.
- comparisons: computed changes; each item has its own observation window. State each change with its own literal start and end dates; do not convert dates into durations or merge windows.
- comparisons.measure: in prose, rating_notability means statistical distinctiveness and coverage_tone means estimated coverage tone; neither is skill or population feeling.
- comparisons.change: computed difference.
- comparisons.unit: difference's unit.
- comparisons.direction: computed direction for this measure.
- comparisons.samples: observations for this comparison only.
- comparisons.window_start: literal start date for this item; copy the date when describing its change.
- comparisons.window_end: literal end date for this item; pair it only with this item's start.
- comparisons.computed_at: calculation date, not event date.
- comparisons.limit: interpretation boundary.
oracle:
fresh contains prepared perspectives about the target, possibly sharing sources. Preserve each claim's actor, measure and qualifications; missing perspectives are unknown.
- journalist: reported stories; title labels a story and body contains its qualified claims.
- journalist.generated_at: reading creation date, not event date.
- journalist.source_article_ids: provenance IDs, not source contents.
- journalist.source_count: linked items, not independent confirmations.
- journalist.source_age_days: age of source reporting.
- journalist.trajectory: summary label, not dated measurements or causes.
- scout: measured performance; each number and band belongs only to its named measure. Preserve the stated standing even when a lower raw value is better; do not infer a different band from the number.
- scout.generated_at: reading creation date, not event date.
- scout.direction: summary label, not dated measurements or changes in every attribute.
- influencer: coverage tone or attributed reactions.
- influencer.generated_at: reading creation date, not event date.
- analyst: performance/coverage relationship.
- analyst.generated_at: reading creation date, not event date.
- analyst.direction: summary label, not dated measurements or changes in every attribute.
- insider: movement or appointment reporting.
- insider.generated_at: reading creation date, not event date.
Read each body's actual claims before combining perspectives. Keep its actor, measurement and qualification attached. Several perspectives may rest on the same story. The overall reading must stay within the supplied bodies, including their conditions and sample limits.
